topics.label: Offshore Wind
topics.description: Policy proposals for offshore wind development.
topics.compareInstruction: Compare and contrast the proposal under review with the ideal offshore wind proposal described above. For each attribute, note whether the reviewed proposal matches, falls short of, or exceeds the ideal, and flag anything the ideal calls for that the reviewed proposal does not appear to address at all.

attributes.name: Transmission Systems
attributes.proposal: Work with neighboring states, federal agencies, and other relevant entities to develop a regional plan for offshore wind transmission.

attributes.name: Education and Training
attributes.proposal: Advance education and training programs to grow a new offshore wind workforce.

attributes.name: Supply Chains
attributes.proposal: Expand local supply chains to support the development of the offshore wind industry.

attributes.name: Port Infrastructure
attributes.proposal: Support the redevelopment of and improvements to critical port infrastructure to support the offshore wind industry.  Should include specific funding proposals.

topics.label: Transportation
topics.description: Policy proposals related to the transportation sector

attributes.name: EVs on the road
attributes.proposal: Set a specific target, or targets, for EVs on the road by certain dates.

attributes.name: Charging stations
attributes.proposal: Set a specific target, or targets, for charging stations by certain dates.

attributes.name: Single Occupancy Vehicles
attributes.proposal: Set specific goals for reducing single-occupancy vehicles on the roads by certain dates.

attributes.name: Telework
attributes.proposal: Investigate, discuss the use of teleworking to reduce vehicular traffic.

attributes.name: eBikes
attributes.proposal: Launch an eBike incentive program to promote eBike use.

attributes.name: Bicycle Infratructure
attributes.proposal: Invest in bicycle and pedestrian infrastructure to increase utilization of non-vehicular modes of transportation.

attributes.name: Multimodal Transportation
attributes.proposal: Implement policies to promote multimodal transportation, prioritizing transportation infrastructure projects that benefit all road users over those that promote exclusive use of automobiles.
